info.name: Rentdo API
info.description: REST API for the Rentdo platform — covering property listings, hotel bookings, technician marketplace, reviews, notifications, and admin operations.

request.description:
Single call that gives clients everything they need to configure themselves:
site info, languages, currencies, active payment gateways (no secrets),
feature toggles, limits, map provider public key, property types,
and technician categories.

Response is cached for 5 minutes.

Return all translation strings for the given locale, grouped by translation group.
Response: { "auth": { "login": "Login" }, "common": { "save": "Save" }, ... }

Return active custom fields for a given property type.
Used by listing forms to know which extra fields to render.
Return the canonical list of property types the platform supports.

Return the list of amenity options clients can attach to a listing
via the utility_flags JSON field. Configurable via admin settings
(property_amenity_options), with sensible defaults.
Send registration OTP to phone. Returns 409 if phone already registered.
Verify OTP, create user, return Sanctum token.

Two flows:
  1. Email + password → immediate token.
  2. Phone only        → send OTP, return {otp_sent: true, otp: "..."}.
  3. Phone + otp       → verify OTP, return token.

Exchange a Google/Facebook token for a Sanctum token.
Creates an account on first sign-in.
Send password reset via email (token link) or phone (OTP).
Reset password via email token or phone OTP.
Send registration OTP to phone. Returns 409 if phone already registered.
Verify OTP, create user, return Sanctum token.
Shortcut for active top-level country zones. Cached for 1 day.

Finds the nearest active zone to the supplied coordinate.
Uses a bounding-box pre-filter then Haversine ORDER BY for accuracy.

Query parameters:
  lat    – required, decimal
  lng    – required, decimal
  type   – country|state|city|area (default: area)
  radius – bounding-box search radius in km (default: 50)

Query parameters:
  parent_id   – filter to children of a zone
  type        – country|state|city|area
  search      – name substring match
  active_only – 0|1, default 1
  mode        – flat (default, paginated) | tree (nested, cached)
  per_page    – default 50, max 200
Single zone with its immediate children and parent breadcrumb.

All active area-type children under a given parent zone (city or state).
Cached per parent zone.

Paginated listing search with filters, sorting, map-bounds support,
and facet counts in meta.
Straight-line (Haversine) distance from the listing to a user-supplied coordinate.

Returns a shareable deep link, web URL, WhatsApp-ready text, and
OpenGraph meta for the given active listing.

Public endpoint. Returns per-date availability and pricing for hotel listings.
Window is capped at 365 days to prevent large result sets.
Suggest technicians for a listing based on its zone.
Full listing detail. Active listings are public; owner can view any status.

Suggest technicians available for a given zone using scopeAvailableForZone.
Also usable via GET /listings/{id}/suggested-technicians (same logic, zone derived from listing).
Browse active, verified technicians. Filter by category, zone, sort by rating.
Full technician profile: skills, rate, area, rating, completed jobs count.
List all active subscription plans ordered by sort_order.
Show a single active plan.
List all active listing packages (post-quota bundles), ordered by price.
List all active categories ordered by sort_order.

Paginated visible reviews for a reviewable entity.
Includes avg_rating, total_count, and rating_distribution summary.

Public endpoint. Returns listings side-by-side with key attributes
for rendering a comparison table on the website or app.
Revoke the current Sanctum token.
Replaces the current avatar. Stores in public disk under avatars/{id}/.

Upload a NID/passport document → sets status to "pending".
Document is stored privately (never publicly accessible via URL).

Returns a nested map: { event: { channel: bool } }.
Missing rows default to enabled (true).

Accepts a partial map of { event: { channel: bool } }.
Only provided combinations are updated; omitted ones are untouched.

Generates a full data export for the authenticated user (GDPR Art. 20).
Dispatches a queued job and returns a signed download URL valid for 1 hour.
On sync queue (shared hosting), the file is ready immediately.

..

Streams the pre-generated export file to the client.

Initiates account deletion with a 30-day grace period.
Within the grace period the user can log in again to cancel.
Listings are soft-deleted immediately; conversations are preserved
(the other party owns them).
Create a new listing. Enforces post-limit guard before creation.
Upload images and/or add video URLs to a listing.
Remove a single image or video from a listing.
Owner marks a listing as rented, sold, or archived.
Owner confirms the listing is still accurate and available.
Paginated list of the authenticated user's favorited listings.
Add a listing to favorites. Returns 409 if already favorited.
Remove a listing from favorites.

Stores the supplied filter criteria as a saved search.
Up to 20 saved searches per user.
Returns the authenticated user's persisted compare set.
Add a listing to the authenticated user's compare set (max 5).
Clear the entire compare set for the authenticated user.
Remove a single listing from the authenticated user's compare set.

All conversations for the authenticated user (as starter or recipient),
ordered by latest activity. Includes per-conversation unread counts.

Start a conversation about a listing. Returns the existing conversation
if one already exists between this pair for this listing.
The opening message is sent in the same request.

Paginated messages (newest first). Marks all incoming unread messages
as read as a side effect of loading.
Send a message. Broadcasts to the private channel immediately.
Explicitly mark all incoming messages as read (useful for cross-device sync).

Returns the listing owner's phone number, subject to:
  - owner's phone_visibility setting (403 if 'none')
  - per-user monthly reveal quota (429 when exhausted)
  - idempotent: revealing the same listing again in the same period is free

A unified, listing-filterable feed of visit requests, contact reveals,
and inbound conversations across the authenticated owner's listings.
Request a visit for a listing.

List visits for the authenticated user.
Requesters see visits they made; listing owners see incoming requests.

Confirm or cancel a visit.
  - Requester: can cancel their own pending visit.
  - Listing owner: can confirm or cancel any pending visit.
List users the authenticated user has blocked.
Block a user. Idempotent — silently returns 200 if already blocked.
Unblock a user.

Submit a report for a user, listing, or review.
One report per reporter per entity (subsequent submissions update the reason/details).

Owner-only. Block/unblock dates and set per-date price overrides.

Body:
  from           Y-m-d (inclusive)
  to             Y-m-d (exclusive — same convention as bookings)
  is_available   bool  (optional)
  override_price int   (optional, null to clear)
List the authenticated user's bookings.

Create a hotel booking.

Idempotency: include X-Idempotency-Key header to make the request
idempotent. Repeating with the same key durably returns the original
booking response, even after a cache flush.

Race conditions: a distributed lock on (listing, check_in, check_out)
prevents double-booking under concurrent requests.
Show a single booking. Guest or listing owner may view.

Cancel a booking and compute the refund entitlement.
The actual refund payment is processed in Phase 10.

Query param: ?preview=1 returns refund info without cancelling.

Submit a technician application (pending admin approval).
A user can only have one technician profile.
Update the authenticated user's technician profile.

List bookings. role=customer (default) shows bookings I placed.
role=technician shows bookings assigned to my technician profile.
Book a technician. Creates booking in 'pending' status awaiting a quote.
Show a single booking. Only the customer or the assigned technician may view.

Technician submits a quote. Booking must be 'pending'.
Moves booking status to 'quoted'.

Customer accepts the latest pending quote.
Booking moves to 'accepted', agreed_amount set, other quotes rejected.

Customer rejects the latest pending quote.
Booking reverts to 'pending' if no other pending quotes remain.
List maintenance requests. role=tenant (default) or role=owner.

Tenant submits a maintenance request for a property.
Gated behind the 'maintenance_requests' subscription feature.
Marks a rent payment paid; issues a receipt when the 'receipts' feature is unlocked.
Generates an agreement document from a template (or the owner's default) for a tenancy.

Subscribe to a plan.

payment_method=wallet: deducts from wallet balance and activates immediately.
payment_method=gateway (default): creates a pending subscription + pending payment
                                  for Phase 10 gateway completion.
Show the authenticated user's current (or most recent) subscription.
Cancel the active subscription. Access ends at the original ends_at date.

Return the authenticated user's post-limit status and feature gate map.
The feature_gates object maps every known feature to a boolean, so the
frontend can lock/unlock UI elements without knowing the full feature list.

Purchase a listing package to add extra post quota.

payment_method=wallet: deducts from wallet and creates a paid payment immediately.
payment_method=gateway (default): creates a pending payment for Phase 10.

Show the authenticated user's wallet balance.
Auto-creates the wallet if this is the first access.
Paginated transaction history for the authenticated user's wallet.

Request a wallet top-up. Creates a pending Payment record.
Phase 10 gateway webhook will credit the wallet on payment confirmation.

Validate a coupon code and return the discounted amount for a given purchase.
This endpoint does NOT consume the coupon — it only previews the discount.
The coupon is consumed when the payment is marked as paid (Phase 10).

Submit a review for a listing, technician, or user.
GUARD: the reviewer must have a completed booking/job with that entity.
The unique constraint (reviewer_id, reviewable_type, reviewable_id) prevents duplicates.

Flag a review as abusive. Delegates to the existing Report system
(reportable_type=review is already supported by StoreReportRequest).
This is a convenience alias so the client doesn't need the generic report endpoint.

Paginated in-app notifications for the authenticated user.
Optional filter: ?unread=1
Returns the number of unread in-app notifications.
Mark all unread notifications for the authenticated user as read.
Mark a single notification as read.

Register or update a device token for push notifications.
If the same token is already registered to another account it is
re-associated with the current user (device was handed over / re-logged in).
Unregister a device token (e.g. on logout).
Return the current status of a payment (owner only).

Initiate a pending payment through the chosen gateway.
Idempotency: repeat calls with the same X-Idempotency-Key return the cached response.

Request a refund for a paid payment.
Partial refunds are supported by passing an amount.

Receive a server-to-server webhook from a payment gateway.
Validates the signature, finds the matching Payment, and activates the payable.

Browser redirect callback after the user completes (or cancels) payment on the
gateway's hosted page. Captures the order (PayPal) or executes the payment (bKash).
